title: ALMA reveals starburst-like interstellar medium conditions in a compact star-forming galaxy at z   2 using [CI] and CO
question: What are the ISM conditions (density, UV field), gas mass, depletion time and kinematics of a compact star-forming galaxy at z=2.225, from [CI] and CO?

data.sensitivity: Band 4 rms 0.014 mJy/beam continuum, 0.076 (CO 4-3) and 0.08 ([CI]) mJy/beam/(100 km/s); Band 3 0.012 continuum, 0.16 CO 3-2

evidence.quote: This source has an effective radius of 2.5 $\pm$ 0.1 kpc (cite: vanderWel2014).
The derived velocity dispersions of CO and [CI] are in agreement with the H$\alpha$ velocity dispersion for this source (cite: vanDokkum2015).

recipe.goal: Image and detect lines and continuum
recipe.method: CLEAN with natural weighting; moment-0 maps; spectra extracted and fit with single Gaussian
L' from Solomon & Vanden Bout relation

recipe.goal: SED fit for LIR, M*, SFR, Mdust
recipe.method: MAGPHYS fit to optical-NIR, Herschel and ALMA Band 4 photometry

recipe.goal: ISM density and UV field from line ratios
recipe.method: Compare [CI]/CO(4-3) vs [CI]/FIR to PDR model contours; XDR check
[CI] mass via Weiss+05 then X[CI]; CO via assumed thermalised ratio and starburst alpha_CO; dust via gas-to-dust ratio

recipe.goal: Gas fraction, depletion time, alpha_CO, gas-to-dust
recipe.method: M_H2/SFR, M_H2/(M_H2+M*), alpha_CO=M_H2/L'CO1-0, gas/dust with 1.36 He
Predicted sigma from M_dyn = M* + 1.36 MH2 and re

evidence.quote: This corresponds to a FWHM of 764 $\pm$ 88, 751 $\pm$ 44, and 675 $\pm$ 92 km s$^{-1}$, respectively.
we find a predicted velocity dispersion for the gas of $340 \pm 35$ km s$^{-1}$
